About the Journey

A Sacred Return Home

This is more than a tour - it's a pilgrimage. Traverse five distinct regions of Ghana, from the vibrant coast of Accra to the royal heart of the Ashanti Kingdom, immersed in culture, nature, and ancestral healing.

Guided by experienced local experts, each day unfolds as a ceremony - honoring the land, the people, and the spirit of the African continent. Whether you're reconnecting with heritage or embarking on a first-time ancestral journey, this experience is designed to transform.

Experience the Magic

Day by Day

Your 8-Day Journey

Click any day to expand details.

1
Day
Saturday, 28 November 2026
Arrival & Welcome
Airport pickup upon arrival. Settle into your accommodation, meet your fellow travelers, and share a welcome dinner. The journey begins with an orientation to the sacred land of Ghana.
✈ Arrival Welcome Dinner Orientation
2
Day
Sunday, 29 November 2026
Beach & Play
Go-Karts and a House Party to kick off the experience. Relax on the beautiful Bojo Beach and enjoy Ghana's vibrant coastal energy.
🏖 Bojo Beach Go-Karts House Party
3
Day
Monday, 30 November 2026
History & Heritage - Accra
Explore the Accra Art Center, Je Gber Gardens, and historical sites across the capital. A deep dive into the art, music, and ancestral roots of Greater Accra.
🏛 Accra Art Center Je Gber Gardens
4
Day
Tuesday, 1 December 2026
Volta River & Resort Living
Travel to the Volta Region and check into Agbenoir Ressorts on the river. Enjoy stunning views, cross the iconic Adome Bridge, and unwind in paradise.
🌊 Volta River Agbenoir Ressorts Adome Bridge
5
Day
Wednesday, 2 December 2026
Adventure in the Volta
Kayak on the Volta River, cycle through local villages, explore breathtaking waterfalls, and walk the canopy bridge high above the forest floor.
🚣 Kayaking Waterfalls Canopy Walk Cycling
6
Day
Thursday, 3 December 2026
Wild North - Mole National Park
Travel north to Ghana's premier wildlife reserve. Safari experience with elephants, antelopes, and diverse wildlife roaming the open savanna landscape.
🐘 Safari Mole National Park Wildlife
7
Day
Friday, 4 December 2026
Sacred Nature - Bono Region
Visit the Fiema Monkey Sanctuary and the sacred River Tano where crocodiles are revered. Participate in a Spiritual Cleansing & Herbal Healing Workshop by the water.
🌿 Spiritual Cleansing Fiema Sanctuary Sacred River Tano
8
Day
Saturday, 5 December 2026
Royal Ashanti - The Grand Finale
A royal send-off through the Ashanti Kingdom. Tour Manhyia Palace, witness the legendary Okomfo Anokye Sword, explore Kumasi's cultural centre, and close the journey with ceremony and gratitude.
👑 Royal Tour Manhyia Palace Okomfo Anokye Kumasi

Terms & Conditions

Food & Beverage

Two meals provided daily for all registered participants. Lunch and additional snacks are at your own expense. Dietary restrictions should be communicated in advance.

Medical Conditions

Please declare any medical conditions, allergies, or dietary requirements prior to departure. This information will be kept confidential and used only to ensure your safety.

Personal Security

Security arrangements will be in place throughout the tour. Participants are responsible for their personal belongings. Travel insurance is strongly recommended.

Cancellation Policy

All payments are non-refundable. However, your booking may be transferred to another individual if you are unable to attend. Please contact us as early as possible.
